chunks.content:
import { DocsVideo } from "/snippets/docs-video.jsx";

Weekly HyperFrames highlights across releases, examples, docs, and community updates.

For exact versioned release notes, see the [Changelog](/changelog).

{/* New weekly digest entries are prepended by `bun run changelog:weekly --from YYYY-MM-DD --to YYYY-MM-DD --write`. */}

<Update
  label="Week of September 21, 2026"
  description="Weekly digest - September 21, 2026 - September 28, 2026"
  tags={["Weekly update", "Highlights"]}
>

<Frame>
  <DocsVideo
    title="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Sep21 28"
    src="https://static.heygen.ai/hyperframes/changelog-videos/weekly-changelog-sep21-28.mp4"
  />
</Frame>

Every change to a project is now recorded, and undo can reach any of it. Studio kept splitting into parts other apps can host, and the preview got much faster to open and cheaper to leave running. v0.8.59 through v0.8.83 shipped.

chunks.section_title: Undo reaches every change, whoever made it
chunks.content:
Every write to a project is now kept in a history you can undo or restore ([56c48a79b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/56c48a79beca307bbc05c2b0e70da47d933d6180), [#4431](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4431)). `hyperframes preview` keeps that history, and Studio can tell its own edits apart from an agent's ([177464b4c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/177464b4c148a5091ccd745ca16d69d9bedd53f6), [#4437](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4437)). Undo and redo in Studio step through the whole history, including changes an agent or another tool made ([36f8bd0e9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/36f8bd0e9112f4af7a09941b3f0f52864d5bd501), [#4456](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4456)). A host app can make Cmd+Z undo the newest change, whoever made it ([b165b64ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b165b64eda845f46f9b622b96e4545bf704d0950), [#4603](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4603)).

From the command line, `hyperframes history` lists, undoes and restores a project's recorded changes ([2734ee2c0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2734ee2c02ef858f3c877c18b56ebcfbb846cb4c), [#4449](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4449)). History can also copy the files from before or after any change into a folder ([7c017a08d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7c017a08de35e013beaee0f388afec7a6e4280bf), [#4493](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4493)). History saved by 0.8.78 survives the update with every entry ([3db3da7bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3db3da7bb284c5f0d89a1f7507d96115236e6bfc), [#4601](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4601)), and the history of a project that no longer exists is removed ([bee6a8e17](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bee6a8e17d9198e734907b06e2c6f167529893e3), [#4634](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4634)).

chunks.section_title: Studio as parts, not one app
chunks.content:
Host apps can take more of Studio without the whole editor. DOM editing works outside EditorShell ([2251e5fad](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2251e5fad01f841700098b91811c06f10d37f430), [#4640](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4640)). A host can reuse Studio's snapping and marquee selection in its own preview ([4aa6b168f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4aa6b168fea84a3a1a129e20d42974427b77615e), [#4635](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4635)), keep paint order in step with timeline rows ([93ab2899f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/93ab2899f13a1120002986793a7b11b657841b69), [#4647](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4647)), and mount the timeline toolbar, undo buttons, meters and clipboard ([bc73c411f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bc73c411f0bbf2b5e79c362ec78300ff5f08c520), [#4629](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4629)). It can draw the preview edge to edge ([326df8def](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/326df8def036e708d25a0ca0e069f91172767b0e), [#4408](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4408)) and change what the shortcuts panel lists ([881481f56](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/881481f56b2682a62dc64b75a1237bc5e06a9bb7), [#4416](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4416)). The audio waveform and image thumbnail components are exported too ([b9fe13ad8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b9fe13ad8cfcbf1c8c0a95cf19cce7cf2918944d), [#4301](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4301)), and component styles ship as their own stylesheet ([d1048cf98](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d1048cf98fc8ee8415f6ce02902ad51ae71cb09e), [#4393](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4393)).

A host's first screen can import Studio's UI and Player without pulling in the editor ([d2f0bc7f3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d2f0bc7f34837da54ae22063772

A large film now opens ready to play in about 4 seconds instead of 32 ([f873734cc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f873734cc4d9fbc13914b9bd99915007ab47ae2a), [#4401](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4401)). The first frame shows sooner because preview assets load by URL ([86fa10ced](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/86fa10ced4297bfd9f4fe67b6767afae7a07fd3c), [#4357](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4357)). The preview only loads and decodes images for scenes on screen or coming up next ([078c49344](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/078c493448cf73241bd9eb885a206ea1ccd951cc), [#4578](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4578)). A file edit reaches the preview 30 ms after it lands, not 300 ([5c3f02c85](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5c3f02c855f90be25699c39fd915223256c323cb), [#4348](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4348)), and the preview reloads only when a file it actually loaded changes ([e00baefb5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e00baefb5c536a10849bf94d0b8b2741aba60b37), [#4570](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4570)).

Playback does less work every frame. The whole app no longer re-renders each frame ([5a74db903](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5a74db903d316999e6210084cd30850ed08d16e4), [#4529](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4529)), the timecode and playhead no longer force a relayout ([471e90c05](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/471e90c057f799fbe7bdb1b03c53bef8e6a46d28), [#4593](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4593)), and housekeeping runs on a timer instead of a frame count ([4ed269ad1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4ed269ad1e3df0f948ded6320be08cb1058910db), [#4595](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4595)). A paused preview stops running its audio output ([36db44d9b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/36db44

The timeline has audio level meters at its right edge ([97420736d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/97420736d56e6feef7396c8d100a33b2e913844a), [#4193](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4193)) with faders for groups and the master ([6f6d24248](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6f6d24248cb56c200fb6420e9000c63ecdeb1449), [#4203](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4203)). Audio pills show real peaks and loudness ([94609daf4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/94609daf445bb956888872af5faa8d6b635d40e2), [#4282](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4282)). You can type an audio value like "-6 dB" or "1.5x", add fades at a clip's edges, and a video you drop in keeps its sound ([839ae426d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/839ae426ddbcb3ad13ba21c586d87cde3aefa6f5), [#4250](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4250)). Video filmstrips are drawn to fit the clip ([5ca2e7838](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5ca2e78383a1db3ed632a2eb5db9233db125afb3), [#4234](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4234)), and transition seams blur and carry a badge ([e5a037072](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e5a03707272936777abbe3d08e4097fec4937fd2), [#4280](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4280)).

Editing got more exact. Dragging an audio clip's edge trims it instead of moving it ([074466729](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0744667293e141e9ab3ed25d8a81ccc7ec2abbd7), [#4645](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4645)). A clip trimmed at the head stays in sync at any speed ([b3ab28aa4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b3ab28aa443eab102c2967061c7c70996a3651aa), [#4581](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4581)), and carve and duck follow each clip's trim and speed ([7fae35f36](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7fae35f36efbdf396882e3829c10ff1c38ad2416), [#4661](https://git

Colour now matches between the two. SDR renders keep footage and page colours as they are in the source ([c9b3d9c96](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c9b3d9c9628d4c51696147ecd2fd881080e72824), [#4564](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4564)). Forced-SDR renders tone-map HDR footage the way Studio shows it ([3a64ea867](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3a64ea867cc79949b51a482e24773e79bdff1d32), [#4600](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4600)), and Studio's HDR preview uses the render's tone map ([5257dd581](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5257dd581f7c046982a4ec6e8874227e9dc62dbc), [#4606](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4606)).

Frames line up too. A render shows the same video frame the preview shows at each output frame ([e8313b2b3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e8313b2b39674816a6057f4735f0f93df5b21fa1), [#4596](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4596)), and export draws a video in exactly the frames it is shown in ([3def3514d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3def3514d1428b2dba7208c5e1d003cca7d0bfce), [#4565](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4565)). A film stops at its declared length ([79144f914](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/79144f914b88d79dd76cee084d40bd6fbf80feb9), [#4530](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4530)). Renders use the font named in a `var()` fallback ([04d56d06a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/04d56d06aa2c9485c7c36e58fc74c224efdf7119), [#4619](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4619)) and embed the exact Google font the page linked ([918e39e78](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/918e39e78575ebf277b01546a017245ee2492bcc), [#4569](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4569)). Shader transitions in renders keep scene layout, styles and animations ([4094c7be4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4094c7be4c4f5

`data-vfx-chain` is a new per-pixel effect element that renders the same frame every time you seek to it ([b32b9a7da](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b32b9a7dabf71e97049d1fa91a818817191414fc), [#4306](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4306)). It can capture what is behind it and run two-source kernels such as luma matte and noise ([84e36fc16](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84e36fc16afcc9d5979f92b50b230bf0b8c29bb9), [#4330](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4330)). See the [VFX chain guide](/guides/vfx-chain).

The registry gained a Lottie character walk-in with looping Lottie that keeps playing ([805596174](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/805596174007bff93dc1b5fe25c887e401f2d6d3), [#4316](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4316)), `text-match-cut` ([0945de83c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0945de83c7f51ba0c20c7c0a56421f066a378ee8), [#4288](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4288)), `extended-keyframe` ([b22bc2c97](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b22bc2c9791098dd02778c675e851f286d4048ed), [#4281](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4281)), `colorama-wipe` ([01734fae3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/01734fae3c41b1f0c62779afece54133b1892f03), [#4277](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4277)), and a week-in-merges leaderboard ([d5e00c0e6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d5e00c0e66a8e3dadf6de40e197256195eb4c8dc), [#4264](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4264)). Examples now show the most-installed blocks ([53153d4a5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/53153d4a5470913586633738855a23caa8e0ca5f), [#4284](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4284)). Six blocks now load their own files and variables when mounted inside another composition ([53e2e20a1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/53e2e20a15fb183a773360543744793189557096), [#44

`hyperframes transcribe` can use Parakeet on macOS, Linux and Windows after an opt-in `hyperframes models install parakeet` ([5cbef29d3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5cbef29d3add1b40d08bcdf2c1ffcf758b8b7f5d), [#4583](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4583)). Portable agent bundles and installation guides ship as plugins ([0a5e3c7fc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a5e3c7fc48229adc0db1aca1fe2d3c1d81b0415), [#4608](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4608)). IBM Bob is a supported runtime ([105984cac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/105984cac4d8a52d99075cc06ed25ab2f12451e2), [#3930](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3930)), agents get timeline workflows ([4e9059ad5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4e9059ad598add05f9b74346526e7ee3daddb1c4), [#4241](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4241)), and the media skills support Gemini TTS ([01601d110](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/01601d110569967adbfe998e81f77bdeec4b1f2d), [#4377](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4377)). Brand logos resolve from theSVG ([d49e7b95e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d49e7b95e0b0a6577a42710ad2a7e0ca93280866), [#4291](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4291)).

New warnings catch layouts that look fine but render wrong. Lint warns on a negative z-index that hides an element behind the root ([42ae3da5b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/42ae3da5b6c54a6138ace2b983252d363df170d5), [#4403](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4403)), a canvas-level CSS zoom ([201c829c4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/201c829c454dc55582cd0e01a7487228959d88d8), [#4412](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4412)), and a clip that ends past the root composition ([13bee7496](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/13bee74960b089339d9606f9860e607f206b3fa2), [#4633](https://github.com/h

The static server keeps every request inside the folder it serves ([cc19b8c81](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cc19b8c8121d938aa589c50363f3c099e8dec8e7), [#4217](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4217)). A write through a link lands on the file the system resolves ([59e3850f6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/59e3850f6a54f4d853b6cbc9af11032c05dbe2b6), [#4589](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4589)), and background removal writes only where it checked ([03e3755aa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/03e3755aaacff101e8b760329d3dc0622341d34a), [#4540](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4540)). A project path typed in a different letter case stays inside the project ([259f65c00](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/259f65c000b43e6deba6ba89f925dc8cc0fe6e93), [#4514](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4514)), and skill scripts can only import from inside their installed folders ([29fc95395](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/29fc95395debf2e8809f27b2a9943ccc973235d0), [#4356](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4356)).

For exact versioned release notes, see the [Changelog](/changelog).
</Update>

<Update
  label="Week of September 14, 2026"
  description="Weekly digest - September 14, 2026 - September 21, 2026"
  tags={["Weekly update", "Highlights"]}
>

<Frame>
  <DocsVideo
    title="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Sep14 21"
    src="https://static.heygen.ai/hyperframes/changelog-videos/weekly-changelog-sep14-21.mp4"
  />
</Frame>

Studio became something you can build on this week. Speed ramps landed end to end, and long renders got a new capture route.

chunks.section_title: Studio is now a library, not just an app
chunks.content: Host apps can take the parts of Studio they need instead of embedding the whole editor. The timeline is composable ([064192155](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0641921558eadcee0a026fa6db39e3e9e5b76f62), [#4229](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4229)), the player exposes a handle ([4ff4435e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4ff4435e1d46f16ae1f10a19109cd7824b9ae775), [#4227](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4227)), and timeline editing works outside EditorShell ([5262062e7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5262062e7be20b26a7c1a4ce4be2ec3831f151d6), [#4201](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4201)). A host can place overlays on the preview and restyle its stage ([ef6432317](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ef64323174c94b58550cb32e59a6819daf1a5e41), [#4187](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4187)), import the render queue ([fd020ca27](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fd020ca27cfd6a3a78524e22d69339a3dcdf1740), [#4184](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4184)), open the ask-agent flow from a picked element ([e174b1715](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e174b1715b6ef0897693a0d278c72343d11f2a1d), [#4075](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4075)), or make the preview read-only ([84e653166](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84e65316683c5636e83720d7d4a8cd612275df9d), [#4200](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4200)). The header logo, button sizes and a stable `styles.css` subpath are exported too ([2d84937e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2d84937e1f28ee60dd7dc23bdedfd324793e10d0), [#4197](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4197)).

chunks.section_title: Speed ramps, all the way through
chunks.content: You can author a speed ramp as a rate lane in `data-automation` ([7f452ad27](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7f452ad27656f14e58403069190c1856b1a91a0b), [#4129](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4129)), edit it in Studio with a lane and presets ([0c158be16](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0c158be165068cbbce55d0613750e7474d3c486a), [#4153](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4153)), and render it with the same source-time mapping the preview uses ([bdecae066](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bdecae066a1a9a1f270b29378975b5a1830de4b0), [#4143](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4143)). The render matches what you saw. No flag to turn any of it on.

Copy, paste and duplicate clip groups ([0b6d1039e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0b6d1039ed0a799fd088fd7af8a4b9440208e23a), [#4064](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4064)). The main track is magnetic and closes gaps when you delete ([8fe480c0a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8fe480c0a0a4796ebc4b12f05f45ac1329707bb9), [#4069](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4069)). Undo and redo moved into the timeline toolbar ([f9fc55218](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f9fc55218880ff62bb580d8a2340cfe4bf323282), [#4196](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4196)). Trimming shows the snap guide and the frame at the edge you are dragging ([86667203c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/86667203ce14adc398326fe75bd5af81a1dd6436), [#4163](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4163)). The timeline shows one row per top-level element ([7797c5ead](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7797c5ead4c0ecd41745b3be9b8f5a266762e603), [#4132](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4132)), and the preview gained ruler and safe-margin toggles ([898d27869](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/898d27869ea16aeb6e58d7f6fe0ef1267ccbfe30), [#4127](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4127)).

The CLI caught up. `hyperframes timeline` prints a project's tracks and clips ([0a5c23517](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a5c235173ddcc1118e68eb6d84d0b01b6895aa6), [#4138](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4138)), reports real media durations ([7597b80c9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7597b80c950f22ab61dcc5fec4bb59e37f05fe64), [#4169](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4169)), lists nested clips in one flat list ([ac0d8ced2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ac0d8ced2a19f2ef9700e57f5b2d2297992cb9e9), [#4173](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4173)), and now has editing verbs

chunks.section_title: One design system, and a layout you can move
chunks.content:
Studio moved onto shared primitives: buttons, icon buttons, tooltips and tabs ([01aa446ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/01aa446edf6a4282a6ac1fc080a002478f91434b), [#3622](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3622)), then menus, popovers and value controls ([3ec26b5e2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3ec26b5e27d0e935c8c30ecceed73ee4ef2599d4), [#4191](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4191)). Every design value lives in one theme file ([339dc7602](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/339dc76026b90828d29700ff13edcb3e364852c3), [#3621](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3621)), timeline colours read from CSS tokens ([9bd6da848](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9bd6da848fb39513ed4e21911c574315aab477e5), [#4211](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4211)), and Studio is on Tailwind CSS v4 ([68b61675e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/68b61675ed4debabe1cbd453b9b926cf76451b5f), [#3618](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3618)). A test now fails the suite on a class that resolves to nothing ([93ff9a994](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/93ff9a994d5f6f7770035a80bf3609d09f15f8c0), [#3623](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3623)).

Panels sit on a dockable, persisted layout ([98e8372a0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/98e8372a0aaaefd498a558db96ed2d2feac3a275), [#4192](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4192)) built on a new dock engine ([dc9469244](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dc94692441d6aaf4ed56531ba1f88ac4c48b76b0), [#4165](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4165)). Dividers and tabs work from the keyboard, and side columns fit narrow windows ([e505dcc5c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e505dcc5c5b507c45b5010baa31b836b934dab29), [#4186](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4186)). UI preferences scope per project ([a192701ad]

Capture accumulates sub-frame samples ([0a1c6f5a4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0a1c6f5a457ca1345d6b8ccede04769a0e009719), [#4019](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4019)) with an adaptive per-frame sample count ([2ab7b8686](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2ab7b8686870cb435674e20d48b4100db2fa2052), [#4031](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4031)), and it is reachable from a render ([b64a7a3a6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b64a7a3a67ae1f5c22915a88938853169eb3cea2), [#4020](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4020)). Registry blur now matches After Effects shutter-based blur ([9aa60a844](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9aa60a844fa645ef92949cf6025ddbb634a97e63), [#4008](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4008)), and you mark an element to blur it instead of calling a function ([752b55278](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/752b55278986089636aaf3b2eb113d1da2f037d7), [#4045](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4045)). A capture route that cannot blur fails loudly instead of quietly shipping sharp frames ([77a45f608](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/77a45f6080daedd12ab67a3d1c9d165b8ae003b3), [#4026](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4026)).

There is a new segmented capture route for long-form work. It plans segments, writes a manifest keyed by a content-addressed plan hash, skips segments it already validated on resume, and recycles the browser between segments. It is **opt-in behind `HF_SEGMENTED_CAPTURE`** and is not the default yet. The flip to routing long renders through it automatically is a separate release step, gated on a 40-minute soak.

Reliability work landed alongside it. Disk capture stops early when the frames cannot fit ([35a4fe1da](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/35a4fe1da7e6564693fbc96996eeaa96836a2ca5), [#4164](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4164)), a dead browser tab retries once ([73f39862f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/73f39862f2019a13d9a36f635c808e5cba7fc57e), [#4162](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4162)), and a CDP screenshot refusal retries instead of failing the render ([a0a6244be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a0a6244be7a40956c5343f5846609e584ee5c6b5), [#3892](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3892)). Render events now carry Chrome memory and the capture path they took.

Playback waits for real readiness instead of guessing. Play gates on composition readiness ([72b223d57](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/72b223d57f5bf21c91ba77c244254672bf9c6023), [#4054](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4054)), cross-origin compositions wait for their assets ([a7282dcd0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a7282dcd0eb888ab496dcbd41a1e35ac2a3bb1c7), [#4103](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4103)), and the interactive clock absorbs a main-thread stall instead of skipping past it ([2de3ca5f8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2de3ca5f86da3b8bb2fdc3e62dd181c4ca565f55), [#4053](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4053)). A finished film rests on its last frame ([f4e00ce2b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f4e00ce2b52591bd901d937debb1922b321cb0d7), [#4158](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4158)), and a WebGPU composition never renders silently blank ([9981d9afb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9981d9afb74e1280bf7136cd0043d895cb570b24), [#4091](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4091)).

A composition with no authored length now takes it from its clips ([fa44d7621](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fa44d7621d3aa664761731322a6cda62b1444b58), [#4174](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4174)), with video, audio and image length coming from one shared resolver ([09aadd86a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/09aadd86a5b87805bb4917604199e4367627d8d7), [#4166](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4166)). HLS is available as an output format from both the producer ([462f9db73](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/462f9db73dc0951a112a057416d03effb2fcf1a0), [#4014](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4014)) and the CLI ([e4b1832fa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e4b1832fadd4c063bcf9a19cd351684815fbc23e), [#4022](https://github.com/heyg

macOS 12 users get Chrome 150 automatically and can render again ([0cde88433](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0cde88433071eb0572ebe84f3b5c1680f54f537c), [#4185](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4185)). Capture runs are bounded and WebGL navigation degrades instead of hanging ([952e9228b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/952e9228b5cdf4387ecb4b6f220ef8e5d9143a73), [#4215](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4215)). A failed Docker render names the container's last error ([45f92e557](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/45f92e55725364003718b7e3c36e05179dcbf43a), [#4168](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4168)), and a missing or stale Studio build is caught before it crashes ([de9206e0f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/de9206e0f8512ea6fca539c981c1688db6771045), [#4076](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4076)).

For exact versioned release notes, see the [Changelog](/changelog).
</Update>

<Update
  label="Week of September 7, 2026"
  description="Weekly digest - September 7, 2026 - September 14, 2026"
  tags={["Weekly update", "Highlights"]}
>

<Frame>
  <DocsVideo
    title="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Sep07 14"
    src="https://static.heygen.ai/hyperframes/changelog-videos/weekly-changelog-sep07-14.mp4"
  />
</Frame>

Studio spent the week getting faster and quieter. A paused editor now costs almost nothing, and scrubbing a long composition no longer stalls. The rest of the week went into trust. Messages between a preview and the page that hosts it are now authenticated, and anything HyperFrames downloads is checked before it is used. v0.8.32 through v0.8.40 shipped.

chunks.section_title: Studio stops working when you stop
chunks.content:
- A paused editor no longer redraws its overlays sixty times a second ([9549e038c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9549e038c43a72305275e0e1732fb0d7723bf84c), [#3846](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3846)).
- A paused preview stops burning CPU ([d4fba55a4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d4fba55a4ee632f74484c6c7498a132b9928ce03), [#3845](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3845)).
- Scrubbing a large composition no longer stalls the editor ([0408fbcd9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0408fbcd9989331a88a0b647368a33957cbbb257), [#3842](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3842)).
- Studio rebuilds and seeks are now sublinear in the size of the composition ([8bf5b4423](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8bf5b4423e704ea4578b9fd5dd988907fbfc45bf), [#3837](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3837)).
- The editor stops waking during a drag on a preview it did not build ([c752b89bc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c752b89bc9de5418bb34c5c7efa71fac0b69cc48), [#3850](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3850)).
- A selector's occurrence index resolves once per layer walk instead of once per element ([ac27b1534](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ac27b1534f45ae6d8250842613a769ec220c9c47), [#3831](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3831)).
- One timing resolver serves a whole pass, and duration is derived only when the composition changes ([3ea2f909e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3ea2f909e15ed11a556812788e328f2dd4893c42), [#3824](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3824)).

chunks.section_title: Messages between frames name their sender
chunks.content:
- Studio preview messages are authenticated ([4f77c282d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4f77c282dafe044ab773d8ecb5c96f6fa8b5ebf6), [#3812](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3812)).
- Runtime control messages are authenticated ([b8328f957](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b8328f957368713d288900957eb5bee0dca31dd9), [#3813](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3813)).
- Slideshow navigation senders are authenticated ([8d80530ff](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8d80530ff4507a87a8689aa3f48e6062859540d2), [#3820](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3820)).
- Deck sound effect messages are authenticated ([c6010f2eb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c6010f2eb82ff3f0331f4d65c333fba800623857), [#3819](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3819)).
- Runtime and playground message dispatch is restricted to what each page actually handles ([05d726105](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/05d7261052f9d2585af0538967849383dc391119), [#3816](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3816)).

chunks.section_title: Downloads are checked before they are used
chunks.content:
- Every download redirect target is validated ([a7e2e3853](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a7e2e3853a347c862d0d910515c7224a14b114f0), [#3841](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3841)).
- Capture and render share one host policy, and localhost aliases are blocked ([96637aeb1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/96637aeb1c38a0d9fec0522b0ba1bbb84aa6b301), [#3844](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3844)).
- Hosted preview asset downloads are confined ([cd1a996ba](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cd1a996ba4d31136b237b4f3c178f91982a27488), [#3843](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3843)).
- Captured images and fonts are validated ([1aa5b9e4f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1aa5b9e4fac929ca1cf097e3a99c075fada7a37f), [#3809](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3809)).
- Captured Lottie archives and previews are validated ([26916b7bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/26916b7bddbcc2ef782a59bd31c79801ff5258b4), [#3811](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3811)).
- Registry installation is bounded and validated ([caa72de35](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/caa72de3550bfe5cc46dbd6d7ef846b752635659), [#3814](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3814)).
- CDN script integrity is verified before the script is inlined ([ff749b870](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ff749b870555f5248df1f452d1135ef985551f86), [#3822](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3822)).
- Staged asset content is verified before a manifest publishes ([962c95406](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/962c95406d361d9775944f045779a590762f32b7), [#3832](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3832)).
- A failed download leaves existing output alone ([d393541c2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d393541c2bfb206eb8af35e60d96c71a1bb167f3), [#3840](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3840)

- A timed-out browser initialization retries once ([d0ee207b0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d0ee207b06432edc48d3d0879c4cb4ca387cd0fd), [#3801](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3801)).
- A drawElement failure retries on a fresh screenshot page ([6a206ffea](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6a206ffea637a936e6379545d371a44bc80a9119), [#3805](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3805)).
- Capture stalls are bounded and recovered ([9308eadcf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9308eadcfc76a98dd23fb9c8948f866f90a4e339), [#3700](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3700)).
- Check retries system Chrome after a managed launch crash ([c5b7f6aea](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c5b7f6aeab689e68642ce7dd0ac18fe574f8888c), [#3701](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3701)).
- Preflight verifies that Chrome can actually execute ([c2702e4c7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c2702e4c76d9c55f12a44641efd14e66c3749702), [#3802](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3802)).
- Malformed JPEG input is rejected before encoding ([b22afd6bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b22afd6bbcd99727abc69415377b57fe4b70514d), [#3804](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3804)).
- Unsupported ProRes rate controls are rejected ([2f7b7a952](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2f7b7a95293bd8c21219604f3a05622df3eaeec9), [#3702](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3702)).
- Confirmed unsupported SDR encoders are rejected ([63182f6a9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/63182f6a93b7006fa629a7424d7238baa89ad962), [#3679](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3679)).
- VideoToolbox runs with quality options it supports ([e1fda7866](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e1fda7866ed94486b1b6c040b2f6fcf52f79fb86), [#3687](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3687)).
- Verification fallba

- Looks is now the default render quality at CRF 16, and delivery is high ([f059a6eb5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f059a6eb539e6289d20156f04eb04a43ddc8b806), [#3927](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3927)).
- A local auto render requests BeginFrame unless PRODUCER_FORCE_SCREENSHOT says otherwise, and the render summary names the capture path, the GPU mode and the stage timings.
- A bare init scaffolds a centered blank stage with no prompts.
- The gsap_exit_missing_hard_kill lint rule is gone. Its hazard did not reproduce on cold workers.

- The audio skill carves the music bed at 0.8 by default ([2e2b5c853](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2e2b5c8530580be28b9d786b70a529a649aa85a8), [#3878](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3878)).
- The carve releases over 2.4 seconds, so the bed swells back across a breath instead of snapping ([fe53f51ad](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fe53f51adb3d0bf09d0be687044728a990098f99)).
- Skills now require the carve whenever music plays under a voice ([0b9852fee](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0b9852fee44b63679f3056d4ede65fb0e58bc1e3)).
- Loop-extended background music writes a real mp3 instead of mp3 data in a wav ([42a3e7a51](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/42a3e7a5191d9aaaca7d12313b6378250753cd03), [#3884](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3884)).

- Twenty five image carousel blocks landed, five families of five ([3a7fcd10e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3a7fcd10e036ff0f5837821bb1143ca529934fae), [#3790](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3790)).
- A search that finds nothing names the tier that would have found something ([849ce0176](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/849ce0176ae343f31181cf4517ea7bc22d621f8c), [#3872](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3872)).
- Catalog pages put the install command above the preview ([51a88b956](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/51a88b95660c5f67e66e9c5977226f6ae7b31255), [#3888](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3888)).
- Skills search the component catalog before hand-building a look ([0f8eb892e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0f8eb892e33a7a850cb9c9cb7af413ea0afa0fdf), [#3829](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3829)).

chunks.section_title: Lint and check learned new rules
chunks.content:
- Check flags connectors that point at nothing and stylesheets that leak into the frame ([e5d89f770](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e5d89f770fbe01d8c243999dac59f3c39a62d66d), [#3736](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3736)).
- Lint flags an unclosed tag that swallows a nested element ([2ef76bf97](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2ef76bf97b8c77dd8b76ac40615738eb91ecbc3c), [#3869](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3869)).
- Lint flags hidden-style opacity guards ([2c14438bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2c14438bb038fd1b0dfd853c2004f89a8e6c6d18), [#3694](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3694)).
- Lint warns on undefined GSAP color variables ([4958a9fba](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4958a9fba56dbcde26a6a155dca1379a6ad1a339), [#3723](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3723)).
- Lint flags repeated fromTo state leaks ([e1ff7e6f5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e1ff7e6f530736f696ca55a2f1360f71404cb6e7), [#3699](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3699)).
- Lint flags autoAlpha on clip elements ([6c0ee41ac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6c0ee41ac4e293153847e197f000b9218a0be45c), [#3692](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3692)).
- Opening-tag source bounds survive a multiline close ([f6041d759](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f6041d7597c8c53d381d4c27feb86b305b3317a4), [#3917](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3917)).
- Check clips overlap geometry to the fragments you can actually see ([776c291f4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/776c291f423eb3b0324db6fa88dd482b51d9b436), [#3698](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3698)).
- A missing caption override is allowed instead of failing the run ([00c91d680](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/00c91d6807f57819c46528e0202ef9488268a349), [#3716](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperf

- A composition inside a sandboxed iframe keeps its sound. The runtime stops routing media through Web Audio when the document cannot actually read it ([293829a2c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/293829a2c1bde0707548b230b74b5cdf8e8985f2), [#3937](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3937)).
- A later root-level clip is un-hidden instead of staying invisible forever ([1acc65dbf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1acc65dbf813d5750c241c7e6e15b48329271ffb), [#3893](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3893)).
- The final frame keeps its fractional visibility ([0ce0bb13e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0ce0bb13eb6468529b08df882f990e6c14a9ddcf), [#3696](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3696)).
- A preview shows the right scene instead of every scene at once on some loads ([73dfe35e4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/73dfe35e462482664177d1e6c0767a894e2d7928), [#3848](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3848)).
- A slideshow retries its init at DOMContentLoaded when the children were not parsed yet ([dc9fb6732](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dc9fb673203dda0a2c0951f3b698cf8cd0ea8d61), [#3750](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3750)).
- Nested sibling video layout is preserved ([fdf9ffac9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fdf9ffac953d9d18329907d6956faa58c73ad489), [#3639](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3639)).
- Nested start coordinates map the same way everywhere ([01744f2b0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/01744f2b0c014bc583964221de69a31c0c036780), [#3732](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3732)).
- Keyframes resolve DOM targets returned by a helper ([400925f43](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/400925f4322134ddfd32b96abae6698d6e668409), [#3688](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3688)).
- A hidden loader stops animating its sheen ([4a72a98a4](htt

- Windows renders try junctions before copying cached frames ([b9aae16d6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b9aae16d6dd0353d9ee3749e61b3bcecacc12b0a), [#3740](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3740)).
- npm bootstraps safely on Windows ([131336f5d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/131336f5dc20bc2cc5af30b168693d795d2e4453), [#3705](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3705)).
- The parallel-stream router no longer refuses macOS multi-worker renders ([26513984f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/26513984f361811bb2407bbc0fecf5f5ce8ab666), [#3886](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3886)).

- Producer regression harness roots are isolated per run ([73e791178](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/73e791178c7a4f0c1d5cf5b527d7f4c34275503f), [#3799](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3799)).
- Assembly scratch directories are isolated ([c7891a936](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c7891a93641287f1822e7c866f1a111e28bb6b2f), [#3798](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3798)).
- Skill media downloads stage in private directories ([efe2404cb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/efe2404cbdeb86111d78a2f555aacf44b71f15fe), [#3787](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3787)).
- Studio claims an upload filename exclusively ([91a34ffc8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/91a34ffc8a6ecea34f67c0bc7ba0437ac82fd432), [#3786](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3786)).
- Audio metadata keeps its file identity through generation ([a7bf0d23d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a7bf0d23d9c3ced59877585c7adeeef090b6c319), [#3778](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3778)).
- Catalog cache assets publish without overwriting entries ([d66cd6dcc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d66cd6dcc856a35c3a2f213e0c418aa9f194c4a0), [#3739](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3739)).
- Canonical stores are guarded from mirror aliases ([e5a602322](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e5a60232289d3bffb07a305800ed7cbacab007db), [#3714](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3714)).
- AAC encoding reserves correction headroom ([58707afaa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/58707afaa04371b1d2cd7b5ff9154804add7f652), [#3693](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3693)).

- CLI transcripts loaded from JSON get w{index} ids ([dc6d78b46](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dc6d78b46281ddf39cd5d45f6c3def39fb612a14), [#3770](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3770)).
- Doctor warns when a HYPERFRAMES_PYTHON override is rejected ([ea7e1dbd0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ea7e1dbd0bd2afb77370b946461c4ea16afdb387), [#3870](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3870)).
- The strip layout stops promising a universal per-time filmstrip ([bafc7b4e0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bafc7b4e0067814b4102ee6586d3e118e8ba2062), [#3867](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3867)).
- The canvas and video pixel-hash carve-out now applies to img ([5a95211e3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5a95211e36a3aa0907c59779039158f6acfbef15), [#3865](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3865)).
- A .hyperframesignore negation can re-include a hidden directory ([9c84277d2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9c84277d28c32152aededdb1d9ed6be095c07197), [#3859](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3859)).
- Studio tolerates a WebMCP execute call with no options object ([14b9e2039](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/14b9e2039b69ae70044cc3b657c77e7688069618), [#3860](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3860)).
- Repo-native skills are excluded from public installs ([8820a0109](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8820a01090692020ef6c5d4fb70fdc06b4b3bd81), [#3856](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3856)).
- Transition roots without a duration are accepted ([78dacc828](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/78dacc828c0b1b483efa2c1ef123a7009305d579), [#3683](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3683)).
- Caption transcript data stays inside generated scripts ([c98d6fbac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c98d6fbac8c423dbdb488499ed6df167a994d96f), [#3847](https:/

chunks.section_title: Files are read the way they were checked
chunks.content:
- Catalog asset reads are bound to the project files that were checked ([7a2a69173](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7a2a6917367e6dd7ce22f4c321c4a852dcf58dfd), [#3735](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3735)).
- Caption images are read through checked file descriptors ([41551c7ac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/41551c7acbb4ddf37dffdb6d1020e824da1ca1a0), [#3724](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3724)).
- Studio bundle, signature and runtime file reads are pinned ([97fde27df](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/97fde27df741ba82358f4e518a37bb59e9e7c250), [#3728](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3728)).
- Lint entry reads are pinned to checked descriptors ([f1d0c2e55](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f1d0c2e553ba6e684fb935f22a059a9617cf149c), [#3734](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3734)).
- Engine and producer files are served through checked descriptors ([be86a1ec7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/be86a1ec7d5c35d31c81524983ac377e4dca8582), [#3725](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3725)).
- A dangling symlink can no longer escape an upload directory ([723cd0d78](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/723cd0d7853e2ef5cc4f1b2fba12521ed5d9d5bc), [#3661](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3661)).
- A blocked SRI script fails closed instead of running ([c0303fc52](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c0303fc5237a95469ae1d8b57b2f2239e7556b0e), [#3664](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3664)).

- Grade stats no longer backtrack on hostile input ([eec04340b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eec04340b3535da024126629b54033afedfc42b4), [#3706](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3706)).
- Inert region scans in the timing compiler are bounded ([e78da303f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e78da303f4392118883f9b69e85ca35edc649ddf), [#3717](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3717)).
- Opening tag scans in the timing compiler are bounded ([b94b5bde5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b94b5bde5812da876ef6feb3f43a74fd2a020c01), [#3719](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3719)).
- Transform parsing no longer backtracks ([e5d1d9bf0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e5d1d9bf0e3016fd0bac9981b1f40b03f316da84), [#3704](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3704)).
- Inline style parsing no longer backtracks ([c564daf21](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c564daf21054a9715c6cdfebc60ab1840152bace), [#3708](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3708)).
- Style attributes match on explicit quote boundaries ([7d7003aa6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7d7003aa648c6f98cb62ebe2f357acd3f3710b1f), [#3712](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3712)).
- Preview variable insertion scans are bounded ([fe2cc9205](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fe2cc92050e0f06b07fb13757ca18ba2e72212e1), [#3715](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3715)).
- Font-face recognition scans are bounded ([3610d94a9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3610d94a9850aebb5f530f1457d46b350de45024), [#3718](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3718)).

- WAV staging happens in a private directory ([51a3c7e24](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/51a3c7e24569bac431295fcee5f94b7c1942ace6), [#3709](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3709)).
- Chunked encode temporary files are isolated per run ([f13037ecd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f13037ecd4cdf115fb2f644e294bb9d4b3d3d145), [#3680](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3680)).
- Font cache temporary writes are isolated ([66052255c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/66052255cf6c92125e40ce0c91a732a341f827ac), [#3669](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3669)).
- Waveform caches are published atomically ([e5b351411](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e5b3514118cbd5d2ce97750455078e6b5cbee703), [#3731](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3731)).
- Capture metadata is published without overwriting existing files ([e6d2816e1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e6d2816e1d6efa9a15439f37fafaa166e1181b38), [#3720](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3720)).

chunks.section_title: Studio keeps learning to take direction
chunks.content:

chunks.section_title: Site capture gets closer to the original

- An agent can drive Studio's selection and playhead ([0e558d591](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0e558d591658afcba59a84d53d75112b963a9f0a), [#3515](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3515)).
- `studio_frame` gives an agent eyes on the current frame ([3337cc899](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3337cc899071c40e0bf3c6bc030d91c499c639d0), [#3516](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3516)).
- An agent can edit text and styles, behind a guard ([f84b4c23d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f84b4c23dcc8b4acbb597e3ad1d293788eaa379b), [#3518](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3518)).

- A write-on block and control surfaces join the handwritten family ([5b45bcc16](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5b45bcc16ddc1308fdbadef81f436e56bbc1d559), [#3557](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3557)).

<Frame>
  <DocsVideo
    title="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Aug17 24"
    src="https://static.heygen.ai/hyperframes/changelog-videos/weekly-changelog-aug17-24.mp4"
  />
</Frame>

Grouped audio shipped. A voiceover, a music bed and a sound effect can now live in named
groups, each with its own volume, its own effects chain and its own mute. The rollout
finished by deleting three feature gates rather than raising their percentages, so the
effects rack, the group rows and mute are on for everyone. Two controls did not survive
the week: solo and the group meter both shipped and were then removed. Lint got smaller
on purpose, the CLI preview grew a real lifecycle, and Windows stopped opening stray
console windows. Fifteen releases shipped, v0.7.110 through v0.8.12. The minor bump to
v0.8.0 was not the headline: it marks the removal of two catalog components.

- **Audio groups.** Give an audio element a group and it joins a bus. The group carries a
  `data-volume`, an effects chain, and a mute. Preview and render build the same graph, so
  what you hear is what ships. Mute works by dropping the member from the mix rather than
  setting its volume to zero, which keeps a muted bus out of the export instead of writing
  silence into it. ([524036715](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/524036715043c4685d0fd41eaccb5addf5ce31c7), [#3278](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3278), [602cf53cf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/602cf53cf6d556711dc02592baad5f7e6088e748), [#3287](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3287), [99f42be04](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/99f42be04ce6bce535600c42a8eb694fed8ebc9e), [#3289](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3289), [acfa7c55a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/acfa7c55a2f3dcdb070e304bfb8e7b819d2ef3cf), [#3286](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/3286))
- **The effects rack and its presets are on for everyone.** The twelve-PR audio stack had
  landed with all three of its canaries at zero percent, which meant the rack, the group
  rows and mute were in the build and reachable by nobody. The gates were removed rather
  than raised, so each feature now renders on its own precondition. `audio-fx-rack`,
  `audio-track-mute` and `audio-groups` no longer exist, and a test asserts that no audio
  canary comes back. That was on compositions between 250 and 899 frames, which is where the median fleet render sits. A 2x2 then showed motion and DOM size pulling in opposite directions. So the band is gated on an element ceiling, not a bare floor drop. A bare floor drop would have handed large compositions a 1.8x regression. This release computes and emits that band decision on every render, but it changes no routing. It stays behind `HF_DE_SHORT_BAND_ROUTE`, so the follow-up flip is measurable against a real baseline rather than a guess ([0749cd9ff](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0749cd9ff83ad41c72c7dc6be1b224e9bc27731b), [e9de2fa14](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e9de2fa14f61f503287c9d87ec0487c165ecbcba), [def98f79c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/def98f79c3fa746e805c6fbe9ee51392c267ea1e), [4dbf0d90b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4dbf0d90b05de2c3db7c983641c8785fd9988148), [23854f7c6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/23854f7c6a328ef1f6913160af345c9fda70b036), [#2875](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2875)).
- **Parallel drawElement router.** The router's minimum-frames floor drops from 2000 to 700. A crossover sweep found three workers beating one at every size tested. The router itself stays off by default behind `HF_DE_PARALLEL_ROUTER`. So this tunes what it wi

- **Colour grading and film effects.** The prompting guide gains a colour grading and film effects chapter. Agent guidance links to it. The `--hf-color-grading-intensity` claim is corrected and made order-agnostic. Professional grading and media treatments are documented, with the treatment contracts spelled out ([819ed632d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/819ed632d92229297c833145546effc0ddb6fb26), [#2911](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2911), [2517f1773](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2517f1773fa6afcc9b54b651f93409d7e99e9e3f), [dd9c86d07](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dd9c86d07a12307ef0c15eff88b21b2df73fc8cd), [0c7c9bbdb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0c7c9bbdb0b10acd370865cbdda540ac0ce3f408), [e4eac0c21](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e4eac0c215faec922a866e61f4e37d322442bd47), [1a2c30a79](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1a2c30a7994fc488685e9251a41e40eea2c3bcb2), [12452a115](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/12452a11569812003a067073c0497d69279b620d), [182862773](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/182862773187dc01f08b2c29d2a3a5951afe5c5e), [#2826](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2826)).
- **The motion chapter, rebuilt.** Each rule now carries before-and-after prompts and an exaggerated applied side. The chapter leads with meaning rather than amplitude. It adds the motion-purpose filter, offset ratio, and property coherence. It also adds the worker-boundary determinism caveat and an "Avoiding the slideshow" continuity contract. Demos are rebuilt around motivated subjects and embedded as validated renders ([6f29f1454](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6f29f1454e4d84a94c36574188d92cc8dc3b953c), [cebf66e6e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cebf66e6e8ca6251c8e83c88d1009a00024ffc63), [1f4d00e15](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1f4d00e15e627aa2e6b130fe4f7840198

- **Professional color grading.** Core adds master and per-channel RGB tone curves. It adds hue-vs-hue, hue-vs-saturation, and hue-vs-luma curves. It adds three-way shadows, midtones, and highlights wheels, plus HSL secondary qualifiers. Everything normalizes through one shared contract. A grade you author resolves the same way in preview and in render ([f99fc4e56](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f99fc4e5686239f5ef56d4eb6083bee796ceeddc)).
- **Grading controls in Studio.** The inspector exposes the new curve and wheel controls, with live previews. You can grade a clip on the canvas instead of hand-writing a `data-color-grading` payload ([20ef48abc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/20ef48abcb190e3e9ef132d1b1dd711201d3c58b)).
- **Agent-native grading from the CLI.** `hyperframes media-treatment` applies, previews, and clears a grading payload by selector. Use `--dry-run` before writing and `--clear` to remove. The media-use skill now reads the source and picks a treatment, instead of guessing a preset name ([6d5961b80](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6d5961b8024fe70f87879f271dd91149717d41a8), [4582881d0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4582881d002c361afff59cc1c74ae072a50e17f7)).
- **Media treatments.** A media treatment is a source-aware plan. It composes existing color, effect, timeline, and registry primitives, rather than adding a second runtime schema. Core defines the capability catalog. The runtime renders treatments deterministically. Studio ships an inspector for them. The registry adds matching overlays ([70213c5a8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/70213c5a8526b12c8b26f01b8288d78bb9edc917), [944640c32](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/944640c3283d604383fd437fcca8c63941d8e3d7), [39c2341c4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/39c2341c4d1edf52a00fb8db4a49553c739860cc), [b0d3164dd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b0d3164ddb6177c6b31634f

- **Audio no longer runs past the picture.** Padded audio is normalized on a sample timeline. The mux stops at the shortest normalized stream. The final mux is capped to video duration. AAC packet padding is trimmed exactly. M4A edit timing and priming survive normalization ([4b116b988](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4b116b98802c05f0eeb541878806692eea975541), [532461599](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/532461599b7518f4609002cdb314ff2ce9f3a70f), [63bc525ca](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/63bc525ca90b08356d50ebb41d4e15581c9d3470), [19258ea5b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/19258ea5ba47067e9d5756b122051c467ece0b04), [afc4e96bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/afc4e96bbed21dbcd29544a6be95d35db7dd4eed), [9289551e9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9289551e98958f006ec14af8ae9058096a4932fe), [59c56d325](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/59c56d325723bbcb7c54315023aedeb72b376cd8), [113a4985b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/113a4985b51bc1d77babe7113d6c96bbe46d41bf)).
- **Portable audio padding.** The audio filter chain drops an FFmpeg option the bundled Windows build rejects. Compositions that rendered video but failed to mux audio now complete. Typed audio failure causes are preserved through the engine, the in-process producer, and distributed planning ([3b9552ef9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3b9552ef9db36b133485e4ce805892346e0b9006), [37b88688e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/37b88688e7ae854e377c47fe3d9560ab0c930161), [#2769](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2769)).
- **Probe failures say why.** ffprobe keeps a bounded stderr tail instead of running quiet. A failed probe now reports the actual error rather than a blank diagnostic ([8c5077068](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8c50770684bc87ca67592c45d4101e3c029193d2), [#2772](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull

- **Send-to guide is discoverable.** The Send-to guide is published in the nav and in `llms.txt`. Agents can find it without being handed the path ([911b332bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/911b332bb2131f1b3fc4abbea563bf0c70d165c4), [#2667](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2667)).
- **Changelog video skill.** Captions are non-optional in the changelog-video skill. A pre-build gate stops a run before it produces an unbuildable composition ([807078c7c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/807078c7cde9d5c8403588722d1cd9397c513a0d), [#2729](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2729), [7d312bd17](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7d312bd170baa6fb1d2c247e14fef7c4d1022279)).
- **Codex plugin packaging.** The skills bundle now packages a Codex plugin upload alongside the existing surfaces ([696cbdbbd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/696cbdbbd0e5c83faf72c767126d4a153110f130), [#2668](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2668)).

For exact versioned release notes, see the [Changelog](/changelog).
</Update>

<Update
  label="Week of July 13, 2026"
  description="Weekly digest - July 13, 2026 - July 20, 2026"
  tags={["Weekly update", "Highlights"]}
>
<Frame>
  <DocsVideo
    title="HyperFrames video: Weekly Changelog Jul13 20"
    src="https://static.heygen.ai/hyperframes/changelog-videos/weekly-changelog-jul13-20.mp4"
  />
</Frame>

Automatic media proxying is the headline. Any video codec your FFmpeg can decode now plays on every live surface. That covers preview, Studio, play, and published pages. Render keeps using the originals. Media Use gains a video generator. Studio's flat inspector ships on by default. The engine's timeout errors now name the fix. A large batch of render, lint, and CLI reliability fixes lands alongside.

- **Automatic media proxying.** Studio-server probes each source's codec facts and transcodes a bounded H.264 proxy on demand. The runtime swaps an undecodable source to its proxy. Browser-hostile footage plays instead of showing a black frame. Render always uses the originals ([9ca1e1710](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9ca1e171013c0d74a868f5eda3ebdf93c9566632), [#2587](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2587), [9d148d288](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9d148d288aa1ea1ad4ea687fc21d92f8b5008286), [#2589](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2589), [39b588cbd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/39b588cbd0e196d1d1db14e959f837dc90cf7788), [#2592](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2592)).
- **Proxies across the authoring surfaces.** Proxies serve from the preview route, play, and the static project server. They also bake into published archives. Projects can opt out with `media.autoProxy` or `--no-proxy` ([67eab59f4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/67eab59f44c0609c7299dc7127d864b37d2d1715), [#2590](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2590), [74b4f1e8c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/74b4f1e8c3cb0058583c6d9048708519a6d94417), [#2593](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2593), [35eff5038](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/35eff5038b5f8e825b416b05bd7ea5baa38684a0), [#2595](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2595), [645880706](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6458807066bd4e0c1a6f573423879e97b91ad1c3), [#2591](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2591)).
- **Alpha-capable proxies.** Alpha sources get a VP9 and yuva420p WebM proxy instead of a refusal. A ProRes 4444 file previews rather than going black ([e8371a7ac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e8371a7accfb1ccd88c792898b65910aec60b0bd), [#2598](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2598)).
- **Media Use vid

- **Deep sub-composition nesting.** Recursive sub-composition inlining now handles depth-3 and deeper nesting ([d21883fe0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d21883fe05a5819e910d4747683dc008a0ab5147), [#2660](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2660)).
- **Final frame holds.** Video holds its final frame through the rest of the composition instead of dropping to blank ([2e8f871bc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2e8f871bc86d29ec3369f0eb11f0183b2001a07a)).
- **No phantom capture duplicates.** Capture stops compositing phantom duplicates when captureBeyondViewport is on ([2be8a62c0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2be8a62c0009e61aeae7f713773013afd9b6f173), [#2607](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2607)).
- **Clean CLI output.** Diagnostics and the SystemMemory cgroup notice now go to stderr. That keeps `--json` output and stdout parsers clean ([b179c9536](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b179c95362645c3ca06fa869d698429e2e3d1e61), [#2520](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2520), [d92d1d4f5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d92d1d4f51e2737d19db8a67073da8ae04a16789), [#2522](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2522)).
- **Studio reliability.** Composition timelines are hardened. Stale failed sidecars are ignored for existing renders. Stale SwiftShader layers are prevented ([2b65b4efc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2b65b4efcef9f69ab294aa608b54a89a600ab76f), [#2615](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2615), [2577aaffe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2577aaffeb9703be3d9dd17c0c5fb3c45b6e32e7), [#2621](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2621), [54a3ef200](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/54a3ef2000da635b93c03a41c129a78f0276bf38)).
- **Platform fixes.** Intel macOS background removal is restored. Windows work dirs avoid the output path limit. A dyld crash on older macOS now

- **Automatic proxying guide.** New docs cover the proxy cache, published-proxy baking, and the render-original invariant. They also cover FFmpeg requirements and both opt-out forms ([8c1b6c515](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8c1b6c515401a03e1a8394cff60b4e7410f14f0d), [#2596](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2596)).
- **Send-to guides consolidated.** The Send-to import guidance now lives in one guide. That resolves an earlier fidelity contradiction ([8bfc67688](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8bfc676881c07c3c8ee1f0b6b247cc5f207cd3fd), [#2619](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2619), [7acabbcde](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7acabbcdeb9b55ce9f75c7d35d7f281273a99f29), [#2620](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2620)).
- **Core skills install by default.** The core skill set now installs by default on every surface ([3bb26b0f0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3bb26b0f08142e95126b4934511a09a1e68c143d), [#2554](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2554)).
- **TTS docs aligned.** The skill's text-to-speech docs now match the CLI contract ([428e57191](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/428e571914ee979c815097fbbd26d56757a11056), [#2483](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/2483)).

For exact versioned release notes, see the [Changelog](/changelog).

Template notes: # AI Answer Rank editing contract

## Surface ownership

This is a generic assistant answer card, not any real AI product. The website brand is the subject of the ranking: the `brand` slot carries its real name, and the re-rank moves it into the answer with the one accent highlight. The other picks are competitors, never the brand itself. The chat card and motion remain template-owned.

## Editable slots

Only defaults declared in `data-composition-variables` are editable:

- `prompt` and `lead`
- `rowA`, `rowB`, and `rowC`, the original picks
- `brand` and `brandRank`, the slot the brand lands in
- `accent`, `ink`, and `ground`

Typed copy is length-locked to within 20% of the original. Pick and brand names stay short enough to fit one row.

## Safe editing mechanics

Call `set_template_variable_defaults` once with the existing variable ids and their new defaults. Do not directly edit or rewrite `index.html` or its `data-composition-variables` attribute; the imported declaration is HTML-entity-encoded JSON and the setter preserves that encoding. Never edit `__template_baseline__.html` or a duplicate composition file. Validate after the setter succeeds.

## Protected

Do not change the card chrome, monogram tiles, skeleton rules, layout, fonts, scene order, duration, timing, easing, typing cadence, or re-rank logic. Website colors may only reach the declared `accent`, `ink`, and `ground` slots; keep `ink` legible on `ground`. If a requested value has no declared variable, leave it unchanged.

Use when: Establishing the pain: noise, doom-scrolling, endless feeds, the "before" world your product fixes.
Avoid when: The content of the cards matters; these are anonymous skeletons, so real posts or testimonials need a bespoke scene.
Variables: speed (enum doom or frantic, default doom): scroll pace. card_count (number 4 to 10, default 6): cards per cycle. cues (string, default empty): each cue advances the feed one card, a stepped rhythm; empty keeps the continuous loop-compatible scroll. exit (enum none, fade, up, default none): the loop guarantee only holds with empty cues and exit none.
